item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud glu ru drag po rdo rje gur khang las khyung bskangs rin chen gter spungs khyung bskangs
item.coloph: de ltar dbal khyung bsgrubs (sgrub) drag po'i bskangs (skong) ba/ rin chen gter spungs zhes bya ba legs so/ las ldan gshen gyi dper phab 'di/ dbal khyung lha la mthol lo bshags/ srung ma gnyen la bzod par gsol//
